newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan shares rise in Tokyo on group profit report.
newsitem.headline: Nissan shares rise in Tokyo on group profit report.

text.p: Shares in Nissan Motor Co Ltd rose on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Tuesday morning in heavy trade following a newspaper report that the company would return to the black on a group basis in the current business year, brokers said.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun Japanese business daily said on Tuesday that the company is expected to post a consolidated net profit of about 55 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997, compared with a net loss of 88.4 billion yen the previous year.
By 0042 GMT, Nissan's shares were up 9 yen at 693 yen on turnover of 2.94 million shares.
